request.description: A squat massive old tree-stump creature, wide flat broken trunk top with jagged growth rings, chunky bark body wider than tall, tiny old face under a heavy bark brow, four stout root legs, two low heavy bough hands. One large shelf mushroom as shoulder accent, thin sprout atop the stump. Charming grumpy ancient guardian. Completely distinct broad crab-like stump silhouette, not a standing human made of wood, left-facing three-quarter battle pose. Dungeon Matcher native 96x96 pixel-art concept sprite, full body at the same source pixel density as the approved cast, approximately 70-82 pixels of occupied height, transparent background with no ground shadow or text. Warm matte bark #4A2C1C #7A4D2E #B07A43, restrained pale deadwood #9F907A #E0D2B8, olive moss #393728 #665F3D #908E58, outline #0A0D11. Aim for 14-18 opaque colors; broad connected base/shadow/light clusters, one-pixel contour, top-left lighting. No gradients, dithering, shiny metal, glowing magic, many small leaf marks, weapons or root-spell effects. Slow ancient miniboss identity, readable charming face.
